issues: The choice count is encoded incorrectly as always max 2. It should encode 'Choose 1. If a follower on your field evolved this turn, choose up to 2 instead' as a conditional choice limit; add engine support for a condition checking whether an ally follower evolved this turn, then use an if/conditional choose or chooseMultiple with max 2 only when that condition is true.
The trigger is missing the filter 'when you play a card that originally costs 5 or more'. The onCardPlayed ability should restrict to cards with original cost 5 or more.
The target is encoded incorrectly as only the enemy leader. It should target an enemy leader or an enemy follower on the field.
The damage effect should select a single valid target, then deal 3 damage to that selected target before drawing a card.

The passive cost reduction 'This costs 6 less to play if there are at least 3 Officer token followers on your field with different names' is missing. It should be encoded as a passive conditional playCostReduction(amount 6), but the engine lacks a condition for counting followers with different names; implement a condition for distinct-name field counts with trait/printing filters.

The activated ability cost is encoded with unsupported 'discardSelf'. It should instead use an implemented self-discard/self-to-cemetery cost such as burySelf or a dedicated discard-self cost operation.
The card incorrectly includes 'ward' in keywords on the base side. Ward appears only after the evolve separator/evolve section and should not be on the unevolved card.
The card incorrectly includes 'evolve' as a keyword. Evolve is not a keyword and should be represented only by evolveCost/evolution linkage.
The evolve section's granted Ward on evolve is not represented on the evolved side linkage here; ensure Ward is only present on the evolved card.

The On Evolve effect says 'Select up to 2 enemy followers on the field and destroy them,' but the encoding uses mandatory count 2. It should allow selecting 0 to 2 enemy followers; add engine support for optional/up-to targeting on destroy targets.

The 'When playing this, [engage] 2 cards on your field named Naterran Great Tree: This costs 2 less to play' clause is encoded incorrectly as part of the spell's resolving effect. It should be encoded as an optional play-time additional cost that reduces this card's play cost by 2, not as an effect that resolves after the spell is played.

The play-cost reduction is encoded with playCostReduction inside the spell effect, which changes the card after it is already being played. It should instead be represented as a play-time optional cost/payment tied to this card's cost reduction.

The activated ability uses tutorFromCemetery to put a card onto the field, but the source text says to select a follower in your cemetery and summon it. It should use summonFromCemetery with filter cardType follower and maxCost 8, count 1, then set the summoned follower's stats to 1/1.
The card incorrectly lists 'lastWords' as a keyword. Last Words should be represented as an ability with timing 'lastWords', not as a keyword.
